basis: Infection defined by common brain and renal tubular lesions; other listed sites lack human frequency evidence.

decisions.renal: primary: common renal tubular lesions are explicitly part of the disease definition.
decisions.neurologic: primary: common brain lesions are explicitly part of the disease definition.

basis: Intellectual disability and hypogonadism define disease; skeletal defects/bone loss and severe hearing loss each occur in 80-99%. Ocular anomalies omitted at cap.

decisions.ocular: none: defining ocular malformations qualify, but frequency is unspecified; the cap prioritizes severe hearing loss and skeletal disease documented in 80-99%.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: reduced bone density, kyphosis and genu valgum occur in 80-99%, establishing common structural skeletal disease.

basis: T-B- SCID establishes immunodeficiency; the supplied evidence does not establish additional agranulocytosis or marrow failure.

decisions.haematologic: none: the reticular dysgenesis-like designation alone does not establish an additional myeloid or marrow disorder beyond SCID.

basis: Biliary, cardiac and ocular abnormalities define disease; corneal dystrophy annotated 80-99%. Renal abnormalities affect ~40%; vertebral defects omitted at cap.

decisions.renal: involved: renal dysplasia and other intrinsic renal abnormalities occur in approximately 40%; retained for their potential functional severity.
decisions.ocular: primary: ocular abnormalities are defining; supplied corneal dystrophy frequency is 80-99%, beyond nonimpairing posterior embryotoxon alone.
decisions.musculoskeletal: none: vertebral segmentation defects are defining and frequent (30-79%), but commonly asymptomatic; omitted at cap in favor of renal disease.

basis: Neorickettsia sennetsu directly infects monocytes and causes a mononucleosis-like illness; common additional organ damage is not established.

decisions.haematologic: primary: direct infection of circulating monocytes establishes blood-cell involvement, rather than a nonspecific blood-count response.

basis: Ocular disease, skin atrophy/hypotrichosis and dental defects are cardinal features; bone loss/rib defects occur in 80-99%, recurrent fractures in 30-79%.

decisions.gastrointestinal: primary: characteristic dental malformations are major diagnostic features; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: skeletal abnormalities qualify; with three primary slots occupied by cardinal ocular, skin and dental disease, bone loss (80-99%) supports involvement.

basis: MELAS defines mitochondrial metabolic encephalomyopathy with lactic acidosis and stroke-like episodes; common hearing loss is not established for this MT-ND6 subtype.

decisions.otologic: none: hearing loss exceeds 30% in MELAS overall, but those predominantly MT-TL1 estimates do not establish that frequency in this MT-ND6 subtype.

basis: Axonal neuropathy causes persistent distal muscle wasting in most symptomatic patients (>30%); structural amyotrophy supports involvement beyond weakness alone.

decisions.musculoskeletal: involved: chronic denervation produces structural distal muscle atrophy in >30% of symptomatic patients as part of CMT; hammertoes alone are only 5-29%.

basis: Skeletal fusions, palatal defects and ptosis define syndrome; hydronephrosis occurs in 3/4 patients (75%). Cardiac defects omitted at cap; hearing loss only 1/5.

decisions.ocular: primary: ptosis is explicitly defining and present in 5/5 patients; myopia in 2/5 additionally supports ocular dysfunction.

basis: Xanthogranulomatous inflammation and fibrosis affect the pituitary; histology alone does not establish an infectious or autoimmune mechanism.

decisions.infectious_immune: none: macrophages, giant cells and fibrosis establish inflammation, but do not by themselves establish infection or an autoimmune or immune-mediated disease.
